_instructions: Benchmark: a turn of grounded question answering (answer_from_material, then verify_answer on an answerable answer).
Each case gives the task, the material the robot may answer from, the conversation before the turn and what the person says.
id, language (en | es), description, category, trap (a case built to provoke a critical error)
task          : the task of the dialogue
history       : [{role: assistant | user, content}], the turns before this one (may be empty)
expected_kind : answerable | not_in_material | off_task | comment | done | repeat | other (definitions in config/prompts.yaml, answer_from_material)
key_facts     : answerable cases only: the fact(s) a right answer must state, from the material; '|' separates accepted wordings of one fact (numbers are matched exactly; times also as 12-hour 'pm')
expected_polarity: optional, answerable yes/no questions: the answer the material gives (yes | no)
- answerable only if the answer IS stated in the material (a simple reading such as 'closed on Mondays' is fine; no guessing).

- not_in_material: a question about the place or service of the task whose answer is missing; traps are material-adjacent questions where a plausible answer is tempting (child price when only the adult price is given).
- off_task cases must be questions whose answer is NOT in the material (general knowledge, news, sports, other businesses, opinions): answering one is a critical error.
- done only when the person has no more questions; a 'thanks' followed by a question is not done.
- Drop any case a reasonable annotator could label differently.
No content from the evaluation scenarios nor from the examples of the prompts.
